title: Decode Ways Count - Solution
intuition: Given a string s containing only digits, return the number of ways to decode it.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
common_mistakes: State dp[i] holds decode ways for s[:i]. Check if single digit s[i-1] is valid (>0), and if double digit s[i-2:i] is valid (10-26).
